items.Title: Accountant
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Ready to take your accounting skills to the next level?  

Join our high-performing Business Advisory team in Hamilton and work with a diverse client portfolio across multiple industries. We’re seeking an Accountant who thrives on growth, collaboration, and great client outcomes.


Your role, your contribution!  

  • Deliver high-quality and efficient accounting services across a diverse client base 
  • Assist in preparing business advice, tax returns, business activity statements and financial statements for companies, partnerships, trusts and individuals 
  • Complete jobs efficiently while meeting technical standards, deadlines, and budgets
  • Maintain up-to-date technical knowledge 


What you bring to the role:  

  • 1+ years in public practice
  • CA or CPA qualified, or working towards it (preferred but not essential)
  • Curious, analytical mindset with a drive to understand clients’ businesses
  • Strong Excel skills and hands-on experience with Xero, MYOB, or other cloud tools
  • Enthusiastic team player who actively contributes to success
  • Sharp attention to detail and excellent prioritisation skills
